notes.title: Minor Update and Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Players,[/h3]

We have some important updates to share with you about our ongoing improvements and bug fixes in the latest patch:


[b]**Important** [/b]
Existing players, please note that the [b][u]skill tree has been reset[/u][/b]. We kindly request you to set the skill tree up again by following the instructions within the game.


[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The order of the Hiring Statues in the lobby has been adjusted.
[*] Skill tree has been re-balanced.
[*] Improve Stage 6 difficulty level balance.
[*] Revise system for situations where players inadvertently missed vital Orb artifacts. Unclaimed artifacts have been automatically distributed.
[*] Added objects within stages for resetting the skill tree(stages 5, 8, 11).
[*] Guide text changed for clarity on entry and exit portal.
[*] "Watch out" has been added to the menu guide.
[*] Enhanced voice recognition("come", "here", "stay", "wait", "bee", "frost", "frozen", "ice", etc.).
[*] Icon improvements for Artifact to prevent confusion with Weapon Artifacts.
[*] Target in Sleep mode can now be attacked when specified by voice command.
[*] All ground attacks, including Jump strike, can now be used against Hornets on the ground in Sleep state.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Golems attacking automatically after using the shield skill.
[*] Focused Rapid Arrow damage fixed.
[*] Fixed Mace artifact's tier animation issue.
[*] Fixed tutorial text disappearing issue when pressing 'F' during taming
[*] Fixed description for Elite Archer trait
[*] Fixed some errors occurring upon starting microphone use
[/list]
We're always striving to provide the best possible gaming experience for our players, and your feedback plays an invaluable role in these improvements. Thank you for being a part of our community and for continuously supporting the game.

Keep enjoying Warkestra and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Minor Update and Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Gamers,[/h3]

We have some important updates to share with you in this latest patch note!

[b]Voice Commands[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new missions and rewards for using voice commands.
[*] Fixed feedback bugs that on voice commands.
[*] Added hints for the voice commands.
[*] Added new recognizable words for the voice recognition system. "Sword," "Swordman" will now be recognized as "Warrior."
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjustments to the default formations of minions.
[*] Enemies' placements and quantities have been adjusted in some stages.
[*] Guides added for consumable artifacts.
[*] Improved the minions' stats UI display.
[*] Added UI list of all acquired artifacts.
[*] The game icon resolution has been adjusted.
[*] Collision issues between the player and units have been improved.
[*] Skill recommendations during battles have been improved.
[*] Added exclamation bubbles when units can use skills.
[*] Expanded the minion hiring area in the lobby.
[*] Message and speech bubbles have been improved for better readability.
[*] Rebalanced the stats on the enhancement board.
[*] Some BGM has been modified.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed progression issues on random parts of the map.
[*] Fixed issue of some animation malfunctions.
[*] Fixed some artifact stack bugs.
[*] Adjusted some videos in the skill tree.
[*] Player perspectives issue in certain maps has been resolved.
[*] Improved a few defective voice commands.
[*] Changed certain wordings(slave).
[*] Fixed the issue with disappearing treasure chests.
[/list]

We hope you find these updates beneficial and we look forward to your continued feedback.

Thank you for your constant support and companionship. We are committed to continually optimizing and improving the game based on your feedback.

Enjoy the game, and may your exciting adventure continue in the world of Warkestra!

notes.title: Minor Update and Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello to our Commanders,[/h3]

We have just made some updates and bug fixes to the demo build to improve the game's user experience.


[b]Here are details on what we've changed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect status value of the  Orb artifact.
[*] Corrected issues related to Hornet's animation, skills, and AI.
[*] Fixed incorrect status value of Archer's 'Charged shot' and 'Focused shot'
[*] Made adjustments to the Archer's abnormal range value.
[*] Fixed an issue where progress could no longer be made in certain rooms.
[*] Added a list of commands when you press the ESC button.
[/list]

Our team is always working hard to ensure the game runs smoothly and provides an enjoyable experience for you. Please keep sending your feedback and reporting any issues – they are invaluable!

Thank you for your continued support and happy gaming!

notes.title: Minor Update and Bug Fix
notes.notes:
We have made some updates to improve the player experience. Please update your game to the latest version for the full experience!



[b]Game Update Patch Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] You are now required to have at least one troop deployed before entering a stage.
[*] Resource replacement and additional work have been done for smoother tutorial progression.
[*] Re-balanced Golem HP.
[*] Resources have been modified to improve the readability of in-game messages.
[*] A new feature has been added where minions will proactively shout out their skills.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented battles from ending and stopped the game progression.
[*] Fixed Rapid arrow damage bug.
[/list]


We hope this gives more clarity to the game. Please leave comments in the discussion board or on our discord If you encounter any issues or discover bugs during gameplay.


Thank you.

notes.title: Demo version of Warkestra's is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello gaming friends![/h3]

I'm pleased to bring you some great news.
Today, we're excited to announce our demo launch of '[b]Warkestra[/b]'! 

[b]Warkestra[/b] uniquely combines innovative [i]voice recognition[/i] and [i]intent processing[/i] technologies. These advanced tech features enable a highly immersive gaming experience as they allow players to interact with the virtual world in new and compelling ways.

Because we are in the early stages of this journey, we're hoping you'll help us define what it will eventually become. Your feedback plays a key role in helping us refine and perfect [b]Warkestra[/b].

Did you find any bugs? Do you have feedback of the game? or Do you just want to share your overall experience and some ideas? You can share your thoughts in our [b]discord[/b]: http://discord.gg/ephaKCPeyf


Are you ready to dive in? 
Your microphone is your passport to this exciting new world. So, let's embark on the wonderful journey into Warkestra's universe. We assure you it's going to be a gaming adventure you'd love to be part of. 

Let's bring the world of Warkestra to life, one game at a time. 
Enjoy the ride!
